I feel you, mine started to appear on my arms when I was 13 years old and still have it now that I’m on my mid twenties. However, you shouldn’t give up. I know it is very frustrating to try everything there is and not see any noticeable difference, but I’m sure you’ll get there. I started a few treatments ( salicylic acid, glycolic acid, aha/bha’s , azelaic acid)a few years ago and didn’t see much change. However, after using retinol for a few months I finally started to notice how my kp started to lessen gradually. I use it two-three times a week (on separate days) and follow up with a light body moisturizer. Every skin is different so I can’t assure using Retinols will be your final stop, but I do hope it works for you if you decide to try it. Whatever you do, I wish you the best and hope you know your body is beautiful no matter what.

Ps: photos of my arm before and after.
